ONLY AUTHORED CLAUSE is the play-from-banished permission: the declarative STATIC PLAYABLE_FROM_BANISHED, spelling copied from SHIPPED chn/rift_bind_blue.json and the sibling draft demonbound_gloomblade_red.json (same 'play this from your banished zone' + Blood Debt text).
